management.title: Inspects installed add-ons
management.explanation: Can read details about other add-ons and use the management actions Firefox supports.

nativeMessaging.title: Communicates with desktop software
nativeMessaging.explanation: Can exchange data with an approved application installed outside Firefox.

proxy.title: Controls proxy settings
proxy.explanation: Can route browser traffic through a different network destination.

debugger.title: Uses browser debugging tools
debugger.explanation: Can inspect and control browser activity through privileged debugging capabilities.

cookies.title: Accesses browser cookies
cookies.explanation: Can read or change cookies for sites covered by its host access.

webRequestBlocking.title: Changes network requests
webRequestBlocking.explanation: Can block or modify browser requests for sites covered by its host access.

declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.title: Changes requests on approved sites
declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.explanation: Can apply request-blocking or redirect rules to sites it can access.

clipboardRead.title: Reads the clipboard
clipboardRead.explanation: Can read text or other supported data copied to the system clipboard.

history.title: Reads browsing history
history.explanation: Can inspect and modify the browser's history.

downloads.title: Accesses downloads
downloads.explanation: Can observe and manage files downloaded through Firefox.

clipboardWrite.title: Writes to the clipboard
clipboardWrite.explanation: Can replace text or supported data on the system clipboard.

privacy.title: Changes privacy settings
privacy.explanation: Can view or modify Firefox privacy-related settings.

browsingData.title: Clears browsing data
browsingData.explanation: Can remove browser data such as cache, history, or cookies.

webRequest.title: Observes network requests
webRequest.explanation: Can observe browser requests for sites covered by its host access.

dns.title: Performs DNS lookups
dns.explanation: Can resolve domain names through Firefox.

tabs.title: Reads tab details
tabs.explanation: Can read sensitive tab properties such as page titles and addresses.

activeTab.title: Accesses the selected tab after a click
activeTab.explanation: Receives temporary access only after you deliberately activate the extension.

storage.title: Stores local settings
storage.explanation: Can save its own preferences and state inside Firefox.
